item.description:
Release v5.8.1

Changes since v5.8.0

  • feat(agent-turn-runner): require approval for risky tools
  • feat(AliyunPlugin): add AliyunTokenPlanProvider and reorganize provider files into Providers/
  • feat(conversation-list): show reasoning effort in item view
  • feat(conversation-manager): add reasoningEffortOptional and clearReasoningEffort methods
  • feat(ConversationContextSizePlugin): display used/max context tokens in toolbar
  • feat(kernel): add global reasoning effort and automation level
  • feat(llm): add LumiThinkingSupport.toggle for on/off-only models
  • feat(llm): replace supportsThinking Bool with LumiThinkingSupport enum
  • feat(llm): update MiniMax model catalog with M3 1M context and add M2.1 series
  • feat(LLMProviderMiniMax): add MiniMax Responses API provider
  • feat(MessageListPlugin): gate live-resize skeleton placeholder behind a static flag
  • feat(ModelSelector): add cloud/local scope filter with localization
  • feat(ModelSelector): sort providers alphabetically by displayName
  • feat(Plugins): add localization for MessageCount and ContextSize popover strings
  • feat(Plugins): add popover explanations to MessageCount and ContextSize toolbar chips
  • feat(reasoning): add toggle switch UI for .toggle models
  • feat(store): add setReasoningEffortToNil parameter to updateConversationPreferences
  • feat(ToolManaging): add riskLevel(for:) to protocol for tool risk evaluation
  • fix(agent-turn-runner): pick reasoning effort by capability type
  • fix(conversation-speed): explain unavailable metrics
